description.value: Moo-Lix Ice Cream is a local ice cream destination on Kelowna's main downtown commercial strip, Bernard Avenue. Situated in the heart of the city's walkable core, it offers a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the Okanagan. The late evening hours make it a popular warm-weather treat stop after a day on the trail.
